verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents a first-party Automations feature that schedules prompts to run automatically at recurring times. Each run creates a chat and goes through the normal completion pipeline. Open WebUI Computer adds scheduled tasks, such as running a test suite every weekday at 9 and reporting failures, so this is a recurring background schedule, not a one-off action. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled runs work unattended, and documentation of how tool approvals, failures and run history behave during background runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Automations let you schedule prompts to run automatically at recurring times. Each run creates a chat and executes through the normal chat completion pipeline
Schedule a task that runs the test suite every weekday at 9 and reports failures with the error output.
Run a prompt on a schedule: "run the tests every weekday at 9", "summarize new files every Monday", "check the deploy hourly".
